 Today October 28 city-wise petrol, diesel and CNG rates
(Image by Bloomberg) 
 Petrol and diesel rates across the country remained largely unchanged today even as supply risks remain high in Gulf. CNG rates are also holding steady.
 Brent crude kept above $114 per barrel at $114.36 in early Asian trade, coming down more than 2% over the two previous sessions. WTI gained 0.3% to $100.24 per barrel over the same period.
 Story continues below Advertisement

 Houthi rebels have continued to strike Saudi’s energy infrastructure. On Tuesday Octobber 27, they were behind starting a fire near Ras Tanura, Saudi’s largest oil export terminal. The fire was contained, but it hasn’t been established how much damage was caused, according to a Bloomberg report.
